question: What was the proposed status of RGNIYD (Rajiv Gandhi National Institute of Youth Development)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Deemed National Youth University**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajiv Gandhi National Institute of Youth Development (RGNIYD)** is an institute established by the Government of India in **1993.**
 
• It is located in **Sri Perumbudur, Tamil Nadu.**
 
• RGNIYD was granted the status of a **Deemed University** under Section 3 of the **University Grants Commission (UGC) Act, 1956.**
 
• The institute serves as a vital resource center for **youth-related activities, policies, and programs.**
 
• It offers **academic programs**, training, and research in areas related to **youth empowerment and development.**
 
• RGNIYD collaborates with various **national and international organizations** to promote youth development.
 
• The institute focuses on areas such as **skill development, leadership training, and social entrepreneurship** to empower young individuals.
 
• It is dedicated to studying and addressing issues related to **youth in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Youth Organisation**__

 __
 
• An **International Youth Organisation** typically refers to global bodies focused on youth development, such as **UNESCO's youth programs** or **World Youth Alliance.**
 
• These organizations aim to address issues affecting youth worldwide, such as **education, health, and employment.**
 
• RGNIYD is not designated as an international organization but rather focuses on the **Indian youth demographic.**
 
 
 
• **Central University**__
 __
 
• A **Central University** is established by an Act of Parliament in India and is directly funded by the **Government of India.**
 
• Examples include **Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU)** and **Delhi University.**
 
• While RGNIYD has the status of a **Deemed University**, it is not categorized as a Central University.
 
 
 
• **Regional Youth Development Centre**__
 
 
• A **Regional Youth Development Centre** typically operates at a local or regional level to address specific youth issues within a region.
 
• RGNIYD functions as a **national-level institute**, making it distinct from a regional center.
